description: This PHP source file defines the 'Subscription' controller class for the admin sale module in OpenCart. It manages subscription listings, detailed views, history, logs, and associated operations such as delete and API call functionalities.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription-related operations in the admin sale module of OpenCart. Handles listing, detailed view, history, logs, deletion, and API calls for subscriptions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the subscription list page, setup of filters, breadcrumbs, page data, and subviews.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to display the subscription list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the list of subscriptions based on filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific subscription, including customer, order, address, status, history, logs, and associated products.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Handles API call to the storefront for subscription-related operations, including session store creation, permission checks, and response handling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected subscriptions after permission verification.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of a subscription.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Fetches and renders the paginated history entries for a subscription.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history comment to a subscription, with permission check and status validation.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Displays related orders for a subscription.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves and renders paginated list of orders associated with the subscription.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Displays logs related to a subscription.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Fetches and renders paginated logs for a subscription.
